title: Meeting review — three fixes before the next run
eyebrow: Mock triage · fictional records and dialogue · nothing published
intro: A realistic meeting-to-ticket review with anonymised defect patterns. Compare each proposed fix with its spec, source note and ruling before approving the wave.

tickets.title: Keep quantities at the individual order-line level
tickets.body:
## What
Write each variant's own quantity, not the order total, to its tracker row.

## Why now
The mock order has two variants. Copying the total to both rows doubles the reported quantity.

## Done when
- The two mock rows show 24 and 18, not 42 and 42.
- A single-line order still accepts its order total.

spec.label: Spec §3 — quantities
spec.markdown:
## Row ownership
A multi-line order's quantity is settled from the commercial-document line naming both the order and the variant.

| Mock record | Written quantity |
| --- | --- |
| ORD-103 · red | 24 |
| ORD-103 · blue | 18 |

Use an order total only when the order has one tracker row.

sources.point: An order total appeared on every variant row.
sources.quote: Mock dialogue: We need the quantity for this variant, not the full order.

tickets.rulings: - Keep the single-line fallback; remove it for multi-line orders.

tickets.title: Preserve complete references under the correct label
tickets.body:
## What
Keep the complete reference when extracted text contains only a prefix of the OCR value under the same label.

## Why now
The mock reader truncated a line-wrapped reference and then compared a value from a different label.

## Done when
- A prefix never replaces the complete same-label value.
- A secondary reference remains separate.
- A regression fixture proves both cases.

spec.label: Spec §1 — reference reconciliation
spec.markdown:
## Match like with like
Compare extracted values only when they share the printed label.

| Mock input | Retained value |
| --- | --- |
| Text: REF-204 | REF-204-001 |
| OCR: REF-204-001 | REF-204-001 |

Keep a differently labelled secondary reference in its own field.

sources.point: The complete value was visible, but the reader kept a truncated prefix.
sources.quote: Mock dialogue: The references agree once the wrapped line is read in full.

tickets.rulings: - Same label first; complete value second. Never merge values from different labels.

tickets.title: Read spreadsheet evidence before caching a skip decision
tickets.body:
## What
Require a real read before a spreadsheet is classified as irrelevant evidence.

## Why now
Two mock files were skipped without being opened. The cached skip then made later reviews report missing evidence.

## Done when
- A skip without a read/triage marker is refused.
- The two mock workbooks are read again.
- Their relevant sheets reach the comparison step.

spec.label: Spec §2 — evidence admission
spec.markdown:
## Read before disposition
An unread file is pending, not irrelevant.

1. Read the workbook.
2. Record the inspected sheets and read marker.
3. Classify its contents.
4. Cache only the evidenced disposition.

sources.point: A cached classification hid real spreadsheet evidence.
sources.quote: Mock dialogue: Those sheets were present; the review skipped them before reading them.

tickets.rulings: - Clear only the mock files' stale skip entries, then prove the guard with a negative fixture.

other_actions.markdown: The reference question is answered by Spec §1; relate its replacement before closing.
Attach the read-before-skip investigation and the new guard evidence.

panels.title: Review gate and rollout
panels.markdown:
1. Approve the proposed wave.
2. Test the reference and workbook fixes together on a copy.
3. Verify the mock row quantities before writing to production.
4. Record deployment evidence separately from merged code.

panels.title: No ticket — meeting recap
panels.markdown: The optional dashboard redesign is parked. Send a brief recap of the three correctness fixes first.
